slides.title: Emergency level possible from Feb 2027
slides.body: Drought-hit parts of Tigray, Amhara and Afar, FEWS NET says.

slides.title: Food aid reached fewer people
slides.body: About 700,000 reached in September, 73% below August, as reported. Coverage may be higher.

slides.title: Access and aid are key
slides.body: Reports are secondary and not independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians, keep aid access open
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
